title: Learn in public without turning guesses into advice
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Label the artifact — Distinguish a note, tutorial, test, or recommendation.; Expose the evidence — Show sources, inputs, observations, and limits.; Invite a specific correction — Name the uncertainty others can help resolve.; Revise visibly — Update material errors and preserve useful context..
